title: Narrow relaxation of uniform connected one-dimensional measure length in ambient dimension at least two
author: Antonin Chambolle; Vincent Duval; João Miguel Machado
work: One-dimensional approximation of measures in Wasserstein distance
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 12 (2025), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.286
difficulty_reason: Ordinary Hausdorff-length lower semicontinuity does not identify the narrow relaxation because weak limits can carry excess mass beyond uniform arclength. The authors combine a localized measure-valued Golab bound with a recovery sequence that realizes every cube excess by tiny nonoverlapping branches while preserving connectedness and exact total length. That new geometric recovery also enforces the measure convergence, supplying the remaining nonroutine relaxation obligation beyond the allowed compactness and rectifiability foundations.
